story_overview: At the bustling Main Auto Garage, mechanics Walter, Quinn, Leo, and Mitch work on a variety of vehicles. Walter and Quinn team up on a black BMW, while Mitch and Quinn later inspect an orange sedan. The story follows the mechanics' interactions as they move between different repair jobs, cars, and locations within the busy workshop.

video_prompts:
Walter: Bald man with thick-rimmed glasses, wearing a solid black short-sleeved polo shirt and black shorts.
Quinn: Woman with a short blonde fade haircut with the longer hair on top tied back, wearing a dark royal blue short-sleeved polo shirt.
The Main Auto Garage: Interior of a functional auto repair shop featuring a bright red floor, hydraulic car lifts, metal tool chests, workbenches, and a clutter of car parts and automotive equipment.
the black BMW sedan: Black BMW sports sedan with a glossy paint finish and distinctive dual front kidney grille.
the red tool chest: A red, wheeled tool chest cabinet.
the green storage cabinets: A modular garage storage system of industrial metal fixtures, comprising bright green cabinets and shelving units with contrasting yellow handles and trim.

In The Main Auto Garage, Walter, wearing the black polo shirt, leans over the open engine bay of the black BMW sedan, working intently. Quinn stands beside him, observing his work and asking him a question. In the background, the red tool chest stands next to the green storage cabinets.

video_prompts:
Leo: Man with light brown hair and wire-frame glasses, wearing a dark navy blue short-sleeved polo shirt.
The Garage Exterior: The street-level exterior of the Main Auto Repair Shop, which has an open doorway and is adjacent to a street with a parked white van.
Driven by Leo, the silver hatchback enters The Main Auto Garage through a large, open bay door from The Garage Exterior. Bright daylight streams in from outside, illuminating the silver hatchback as it pulls onto the garage's red floor.

Mitch: Man with short blond hair, wearing a grease-stained blue mechanic's jumpsuit over a plain grey t-shirt, and scuffed, heavy-duty work boots.
the orange sedan: Bright orange four-door sedan with a glossy finish and standard silver alloy wheels.
the blue workbench: Blue metal auto repair workbench with a flat top surface and sturdy legs.

Inside The Main Auto Garage, Walter walks across the red floor, seen from behind. In the background, the fabric flags hang above Mitch, who works at the blue workbench beside the orange sedan, which has its hood raised. Quinn stands nearby, watching Mitch and nodding slightly.

the safety glasses: Clear safety glasses with black plastic full-frames and integrated side shields.
the vintage red scooter: A vintage-style motor scooter with a glossy red body, a black leather seat, and chrome details including handlebars, side mirrors, and a large, round front headlight.
Medium close-up shot of Walter and Leo in The Main Auto Garage. Walter talks animatedly, gesturing with his hands, while Leo listens intently. In the background, the vintage red scooter is parked in front of the green storage cabinets, with the safety glasses resting on a shelf.
